t: From Colab Failure to PyPI Success: Automating a Critical Dependency Fix
s: This article details the process of diagnosing and fixing a critical dependency issue discovered in Google Colab for the Pipulate Python package. The solution involved updating the `pyproject.toml` file and then automating the release process to PyPI.
sub: Diagnosing Python package dependency issues in Google Colab
Automating Python package release to PyPI using a release script
Version incrementing and AI-generated commit messages for releases
